description: This file defines the HostedClient class, which manages a client hosted within a silo in the Orleans distributed runtime. It handles message processing, object references, extensions, and lifecycle participation within the Orleans runtime environment.

classes.name: HostedClient
classes.description: A client class managing message processing, object references, extensions, and lifecycle within the Orleans silo environment.

methods.name: CreateHostedClientGrainId
methods.description: Creates a unique grain ID for a hosted client based on the silo address.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a grain reference for a given object, registering it as an observer.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a component of a specified type, with special handling for PlacementStrategy.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets or removes a component of a specified type.

methods.name: TryDispatchToClient
methods.description: Attempts to dispatch a message to this client if the target matches.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, routing responses to the runtime client or scheduling requests.

methods.name: RunClientMessagePump
methods.description: Asynchronous loop processing incoming messages from the channel.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to lifecycle events for startup and shutdown.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks reference equality with another grain context.

methods.name: GetOrSetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves or creates and registers a grain extension.

methods.name: TryGetExtension
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a registered extension.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a registered extension, throwing if not found.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to retrieve a target object.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Disposes of the rehydration context if provided.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Migration is not supported; method does nothing.
